title: Описание хуков / Hook description popover and configuration schema
author: developer (fullstack-lead)
summary: Implemented hook descriptions in UI and pipeline: (1) Added HookConfig enum (untagged) in src-tauri/src/config.rs supporting string and detailed { script, description } formats with path/command aliases; (2) Enriched hook:start IPC event with description across task progression; (3) Added HookDefinition type and helper functions getHookScript/getHookDescription in src/types/index.ts; (4) Updated boardStore and cortexStore to preserve hook description in hookStates; (5) Enriched CardHookNode in KanbanCard.tsx with hover description popover replacing default generic copy when present (UI Anti-Slop); (6) Populated informative descriptions across backlog, review, and ready hooks in .cvh/pipeline.json, .cvh/boards.json, and documentation.

rootCauses.cause: Gate 6 (Clean Merge & Pre-Handover Commit Mandate) Violation: Uncommitted working tree handed off to Review
rootCauses.detail: Developer implemented changes across 13 files and ran pre-flight sensors, but invoked advance_task without committing the working tree to the feat/CVH-031 branch. Because gatekeeper_sensor.bat used 'git stash create' to evaluate mergeability, the sensor passed on the dirty worktree instead of enforcing a clean commit. Reviewer rejected under Gate 6 because an uncommitted worktree would result in merging a stale/empty branch in on_review_finish.bat followed by destructive worktree removal (git worktree remove --force).
rootCauses.resolution: Developer committed all 13 modified files (4173c2c), merged latest main (5ce7988), and passed all sensors. Retrospective hardened gatekeeper_sensor.bat and gatekeeper_sensor.sh to mechanically reject dirty worktrees via 'git status --porcelain', purged permissive git stash create advice from sensors.md and review-checklist.md, and codified zero-tolerance uncommitted handoff invariant.
